comment: Tier routes of the review-verdict check (.github/scripts/check_review_binding.py), the same five tiers elastic/prism uses, shallow to deep. A path takes the deepest tier of any route naming it; a path no route names (src/, golden-catalog/, prototypes/, reference-statistics/) is charged the deepest tier. `*` crosses a `/`. `generated` lists the files a build writes: a delta that touches only those carries an ARM verdict to the new head.
